# Service Worker
1. Your direct superior is the Head of Personnel.
2. Service Workers are to listen to and obey orders from the Bartender, the Chefs, and the Botanists, when reasonable and actionable.
3. Service Workers are to ensure crewmembers and other patrons are well attended to while in the service department.
4. Service Workers are to deliver meals, drinks, and other service department contents to departments requesting or needing them. This includes but is not limited to delivering Command member meals, delivering service Cargo bounties to Cargo, or bringing medicinal plants to Chemistry.
